items.title: What are the major type of energy resources?
items.text:
Energy is required for daily life and activties

There are 2 main types of energys, they are:

  • Renewable energy
  • Non-renewable energy

**Renewable energy will not run out while non-renewable wont

items.title: Examples of renewable energy
items.text:
• Hydroelectric power(HEP)
  • Wave power
  • Tidal power
  • Fuelwood(Biomass)
  • Biofuel(Biomass)
  • Geothermal power
  • Wind power
  • Solar power

items.title: Examples of non-renewable energy
items.text:
• Coal
  • Natural gas
  • Oil(Petroleum)

All these above can also be called "Fossil fuels"(化石燃料)

  • Nuclear power(Uranium)

items.title: Why fossil fuel are most used energy in the world?
items.text:
• Easy and cheap to mine
  • High effience
  • Can be transport to a place and keep low cost
  • Covenient to use

items.title: How fossil fuel get produced?
items.text:
graph LR
    A[Plants and animals die and sink to the bottom of the sea] --> B[Remains of plants and animals accumulate and cover with mud]
    B --|Millions of years...|--> C[Over time, more mud produced pressure and compress the remains into fossil fuels]
    C --> D[People extract them from underground]

items.title: Is the distribution of fossil fuels is even?
items.text:
No, the distribution of fossil fuels is uneven. Different types of fossil fuels distribute more in some place

Coal is mainly found in Asia Pacific russia and the USA Oil and natural gas are heavily concentrated in the Middle east. Russia and NA are important reserves too

items.text:

items.text:

items.title: The mismatch of energy-consuming countries and energy-producing countries
items.text: China and USA are the major energy consumer on earth, but they dont produce enough energy for their own use.

items.title: The consequence caused by the shortage of the oil shortage
items.text:
• Economic disruption

    B --> C[lower economic growth]
  • Conflict between countries Because the oil price increased, it makes the countries who have more oil want to securing the oil source that will make the tension between country increase

Why they dont use the renewable energy instead?

Remember what is the avantage of non renewable energy?

it can produce lot of energy with low cost

non renewable energy usually have very low effciency or very expensive to maintenance

items.text: The reason why we need to scramble for energy resources is because it is used in almost every activies and it is not renewable which basiclly means it cant be find after everyone has been used.
